title: Worker Output (Strict TDD)
description: Output contract for the `worker` agent. Used for `feature` and `bugfix` task types. Produces a three-commit audit trail (red → green → regression).

task_id.description: Task identifier from the contract, e.g. 'TASK-042'.

task_type.description: This worker only accepts feature and bugfix tasks.

scope_completed.description: Concise bullet list of what was done.

audit_trail_commits.description: The three-commit audit trail proving TDD compliance. Use {"status": "n/a — no git"} as the value for each stage if the project has no git repository.

tdd_evidence.description: Verbatim test runner output captured at each commit. The coordinator inspects these to confirm tests genuinely failed before the green commit.

failing_before_implementation.description: Failing test output captured at the red commit. Required (not 'N/A') for git-enabled projects.

passing_after_implementation.description: Passing test output captured at the green commit.

full_suite_at_regression.description: Full test suite output (or summary with totals) captured at the regression commit.

behavioral_tests.description: Behavioral tests written, each mapped to a behavioral spec from the task contract.

description.description: The behavior under test, e.g. 'When X, then Y'.

regression_tests.description: Regression tests added, with what future breakage each catches.

catches.description: What breakage this test catches if the feature/fix is later reverted or broken.

files_changed.description: Absolute file paths created or modified.

invariants_or_assumptions.description: Anything discovered during implementation that future work should know. Empty array if none.

risks_or_blockers.description: Problems encountered or potential issues. Empty array if none.

recommended_next_step.description: Specific recommendation for what should happen next.
